title: Why Does Ice Cream Give You Brain Freeze?
short_title: Why Ice Cream Gives You Brain Freeze
description: Why does eating ice cream fast cause a painful brain freeze? Here is the simple science.
comment: Do you get brain freeze easily? 🍦

scenes.text: Why does eating ice cream fast give you a painful brain freeze?
Cold ice cream touches the roof of your mouth, where many blood vessels and nerves sit.
The vessels suddenly shrink from the cold, and then open wide again when they warm up.
Your brain reads that rush as pain, and it feels like it comes from your head.
It fades in about thirty seconds. Press your tongue to the roof of your mouth to warm it faster.
Next time, eat ice cream slowly.
